| description = Patrols around near Cabilis entrance, stays stationary near zone-in to Cabilis for about 5 minutes before moving again.

He is on the Scaled Mystics faction (Iksar Shaman guild), while Crusader Bodli is on Crusaders of Greenmist (Iksar SK) faction. This means he can be hostile to players on good terms with the Legion of Cabilis (Cabilis guards).  Agnostic Enchanters using Illusion: Iksar are KoS with Quarg but not with Bodli by default, so be wary of him if you are turning in bone chips.

SEES THROUGH IKSAR ILLUSION

stands guard at entrance to cabilis for 5 mins

'''Pathing'''
He patrols from the entrance of E. Cabilis out and to the right into that first building/ruin for 11.5 mins (will be in agro range of mozo for ~15 seconds heading out/~15 seconds returning, maybe set timer for 10 mins just to be on the safe side).
He will patrol both floors of that building before returning to the entrance of E. Cabilis, so avoid that building if you are KOS or an Enchanter in Iksar form.  Be invis!!!
